# 用AI工具解决内部问题做到10万美元ARR

今天讲的这个案例，可能会改变你对创业的理解。
没有融资，没有团队，没有背景——@arjunpredev一个人做到了年入。5分钟看完，你会发现你们的差距不在能力，在于一个认知。

![@arjunpredev](https://storage.googleapis.com/indie-hackers.appspot.com/post-images/438c1ab476/JAcyjiQbmJYSOUTK9UQC1PNf9D13/8fb99059-b7bb-1784-92d7-30e3faca837f.png)

**【早高峰地铁上】**

刷手机看到一个帖子："做AI一年多了，月收入还在徘徊，该放弃吗？"我忍住没回。但我想到了@arjunpredev。

### 01

### 02

在建立 https://pre.dev 之前，我的联合创始人经营着一家自由职业机构，并开始厌倦了他花在为每个客户制定工作说明书和项目范围上的时间。

因此，他构建了一个 MVP，允许他的客户与“人工智能产品专家”聊天，后者会向他们询问有关他们想要构建的内容的适当问题。一旦客户回答了至少 5 个问题，对话就会被转化为代表该想法的知识图。

这使他能够在客户第一次致电之前就了解客户想要构建的内容的完整背景。

由于该工具在内部取得了成功，我们决定构建一个独立的服务，可供以下人员使用：
软件机构：他们将我们的聊天小部件嵌入到他们的网站上，并在他们的 pre.dev 仪表板上查看生成的 SoW。

创始人/构建者：他们来到 pre.dev 来确定项目范围，并可以请求与 pre.dev 会面以获得开发帮助。黑客马拉松组织者：他们嵌入了完整的界面，使黑客能够确定他们的项目范围。我们一直不懈地接触各种潜在客户，并将继续这样做。

到目前为止，尽早获得反馈是我们发展的关键，并且对我们的平台如何最好地为用户服务持开放态度。因此，如果您想构建自己的人工智能应用程序，一定要在开始开发之前与潜在客户交谈 - 理想情况下，他们愿意付钱给您来构建它！

如果您需要帮助确定项目范围或构建项目，请访问 https://pre.dev。阿琼普雷德夫

content_en:
Use AI tools to solve internal problems and achieve US$100,000 ARR

The case we talked about today may change your understanding of entrepreneurship.
No financing, no team, no background-@arjunpredev achieved annual income alone. After reading it in 5 minutes, you will find that the gap between you lies not in your ability, but in your understanding.

[On the subway during the morning rush hour]

I swiped my mobile phone and saw a post: "I have been doing AI for more than a year, and my monthly income is still hovering. Should I give up? "I resisted replying. But I thought of @arjunpredev.

01

Ajun Predev

You think it's over?

02

Before founding https://pre.dev, my co-founder ran a freelance agency and began to get tired of the time he spent developing work specifications and project scopes for each client.

So he built an MVP that allowed his customers to chat with "artificial intelligence product experts" who would ask them the appropriate questions about what they wanted to build. Once the customer answers at least 5 questions, the conversation is transformed into a knowledge graph representing the idea.

This allowed him to have a full background on what the customer wanted to build before the customer first called.

Due to the internal success of the tool, we decided to build a stand-alone service that could be used by the following people:
Software agencies: They embed our chat widgets on their website and view the resulting SoW on their pre.dev dashboard.

Founders/Builders: They come to pre.dev to determine the scope of the project and can request a meeting with pre.dev for development assistance. Hackathon organizers: They embed a complete interface that allows hackers to determine the scope of their projects. We have been tirelessly reaching out to a variety of potential customers and will continue to do so.

So far, getting early feedback has been key to our growth and being open about how our platform can best serve our users. So if you want to build your own artificial intelligence application, be sure to talk to potential customers before starting development-ideally, they will pay you to build it!

If you need help scoping or building a project, visit https://pre.dev. Ajun Predev

This is similar to your own exclusive club, except for coded greetings.
